title: Engineering mobile software that holds up in the real world.
biography: I'm a mobile application engineer with four years of experience, specialising in Flutter and Dart. I've led apps from first requirements to production — making architecture decisions, planning tasks, reviewing code and shipping releases to the Play Store.

My work spans accessible public-service apps for UNDP Bangladesh and the Government of Bangladesh, a UN Women calculator with a FastAPI backend, offline-first NFC apps for CARE Bangladesh's emergency shelters, and a SaaS platform for small businesses. I currently work as a Mobile Application Developer with the Bangladesh Army, and I hold a BSc in Computer Science and Engineering from BRAC University.
philosophy: Good mobile software is invisible: it starts fast, works offline when it has to, and is usable by everyone — including people with low literacy or visual impairments. I favour clear architecture, small well-tested units and measuring performance before optimising it.
experienceSummary: Four years building and leading production Flutter apps: REST and third-party API integration, Firebase, state management, offline sync, accessibility and release management — while mentoring junior developers and interns.
